title: Customers
source: Sales Analysis · ERP_Sales_Data · Total Bill Amount (GST-inclusive); marketing person = customer-master assignment column; source = Buyer_Source (normalised)

status.rule: Active = last invoice after 2026-08-26 (within 45 days of asOf, same as #label/#gumming); independent of the selected range.

schema.inv: [dayOffset from dataStart, invoiceNo, amountRupees (int, GST-incl.), categoryIndex] — one entry per invoice × category; AOV/orders count DISTINCT invoiceNo (+ date)
schema.last3: [date, itemDisplayName, categoryId] newest first, distinct items
schema.fu: follow-up (independent of range): n = distinct order dates in last 12 months, gap = real median days between consecutive order dates (whole days; null if n < 3), gapEff = max(gap, 7) used for next/overdue, callNow = callThisWeek with next ≤ asOf, since = days since last order at asOf, next = next follow-up date (last + gap − 2, or last + 30 if n < 3), status = overdue|callThisWeek|upcoming|dormant|notEnoughHistory

followUp.window: distinct order dates after 2025-10-10 up to asOf (12 months)
followUp.rule: gap = median days between consecutive distinct order dates (last 12 months, ≥ 3 dates); effective gap = max(gap, 7); next = last order + effective gap − 2 (or last + 30 with < 3 dates). Status: Dormant if no order for > 180 days; else Not enough history if < 3 dates; else Overdue if days since last order > effective gap × 1.5; else Call this week if next ≤ asOf + 7 (callNow when next ≤ asOf); else Upcoming. Due this week = Call this week + Overdue.
